name: Sector-neutral intraday reversal basket
hypothesis: Buy negative residuals and short authorized positive residuals only after reversal confirmation and portfolio constraints.
spec: Setup: Extreme stock returns may revert after removing market and sector movement. Entry: Buy negative residuals and short authorized positive residuals only after reversal confirmation and portfolio constraints. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit on residual convergence, a stop, or session end. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable. Parameters to pre-register: eligible universe and point-in-time membership, observation window and completed-event/bar rule, numerical threshold(s) named by the signal, entry order and maximum price/quote deviation, initial invalidation level and target if used, H_max and explicit session definition, cost, impact, latency, failed-attempt, and leg-risk models, position/notional/exit-capacity caps, baseline and out-of-sample rejection thresholds.
blocked_reason: needs point-in-time constituent breadth or auction imbalance data (not free)
